item.title: The Secret to Every Pop Girl Glam Starts With Skin Care | Rock the Look
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Rock the Look, presented by Neutrogena. Today, we're talking about creating the ultimate effortless pop girl glam with celebrity makeup artist Micaela Cleary.
[Micaela Cleary's voice] Micaela Cleary: Hi, I'm Micaela. As a celebrity makeup artist, I believe skin care is the foundation behind every standout beauty look. It's all about glowing skin prep and soft, camera-ready makeup.
[Sound effects: A gentle whooshing sound]
Host: Micaela meets with Neena to demonstrate her techniques. Neena has just cleansed her skin using Neutrogena's fragrance-free makeup wipes and Hydroboost cleanser.
[Micaela Cleary's voice] Micaela Cleary: The Hydroboost cleanser is one of my favorites. It contains hyaluronic acid, which holds up to a thousand times its weight in water, providing amazing hydration.
[Soft music plays in the background]
Host: Micaela and Neena discuss the importance of hydration and how it helps the skin look and feel amazing. Micaela is now applying a serum to Neena's skin to give it an extra boost of moisture.
[Outro music starts playing]
Host: That's all for now. Tune in next time to learn more about Micaela's pro tips and must-have products for achieving a fresh, radiant finish worthy of any pop star moment.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
